product.name: Corner Trader
product.purpose: QA templates, harness, automation docs, and session handoff for Corner Trader; not necessarily the application source tree.

notes_from_mcp: CT space home page is largely default Confluence space onboarding text; it does not yet hold deep product documentation.
For Corner product scope, interfaces, environments, Jira mapping, and QA entry point, use QAPORTAL page 497097273 (Corner) via docs/qa-project.json and MCP.
Link child pages from the CT space via MCP when tasks are CT-space-specific.

practical_meaning: Corner Trader is built from the DXtrade XT platform line; shared behaviors, components, and baseline requirements often trace to the XT space and XT Jira program.
Use XT documentation and trackers when investigating platform-level behavior, demo environments, or cross-client DXtrade XT features.
Use CT space and Corner-specific QAPORTAL subtree for bank-specific configuration, integrations, and Corner-only deltas.

XT home aggregates Jira boards (backlog, epics, platforms, development and QA task boards, defects dashboards) and demo hostnames under demo-xt.dx.trade (dxTrade5, WebBroker, dxMC, dxWeb, mobile apps, API specs, IPF).
Ignore org-contact tables on Confluence when summarizing; they are out of scope for this harness.

bitbucket.note: Internal Bitbucket Server (Stash): use repo token shape PROJECT_KEY/repo_slug (same string for EPIC-PREP/COVERAGE repo= and for epic-ref sources.bitbucket_repo). default_repo BRO/xt is the Brotherhood DXtrade XT monorepo (dxcore, webbroker, platform code) where Corner Trader bank logic lives on top of the XT line. Adaptive / Candelabra mobile work: primary repo CAN/corner (Nx apps/packages; description references Corner Jira). Related CAN repos: CAN/candelabra, CAN/candelabra-kmp. DXREL/cornertrader is a separate cornerTrader repo (often release/packaging—confirm with team before treating as primary app source). MCP bitbucket_list_repositories and bitbucket_browse_directory work against Stash; bitbucket_search_code may return HTTP 404 if the Stash code-search plugin/API path differs—in that case use browse/get_file or fix the MCP server mapping. No secrets in this file.
